items.title: 8.4 Reflection ke tareeqe se polarized light (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 8.4 with Fig. 8.6 and Example 8.1 (PDF 177-178).

blocks.text: 1808 mein Malus ne maloom kiya ke jab aam light sheeshe ki seedhi (plane) sheet se reflect ho (satah se takra kar wapas aaye) to polarized light milti hai. Agar reflect hone wali light ko polaroid se dekhein aur polaroid ko nazar ki lakeer ke gird aahista ghumayein, to polaroid ki ek position par light taqreeban bujh jati hai. Sheeshe ke liye sab se munasib angle of incidence ‘i’ taqreeban 57° hai, jis par reflect hone wali ray plane polarized ho jati hai (ray diagram, Fig. 8.6). Is se sabit hota hai ke sheeshe se reflect hone wali light taqreeban plane polarized hai. Mez ki satah se reflect hone wali light ghumai hui polaroid se dekhne par madhham hoti hai, yani woh partially (kuch had tak) plane polarized hai.

blocks.alt: Ray diagram. Har simt mein vibrations wali unpolarized light Medium 1 (n1, hawa) aur Medium 2 (n2, crown glass, n = 1.52; n2 > n1) ki sarhad par dashed normal se i = theta_p = 57 degrees par parti hai. Mun'akis plane polarized light ki vibrations nuqton (dots) se dikhai gayi hain aur use polaroid se dekha jata hai. r = theta_r par refracted light par dohre teer hain. Mun'akis aur refracted shuaon mein 90 degrees.
blocks.caption: Figure 8.6: Reflection se plane polarization (kitab ki Figure 8.6 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Crown glass (n = 1.52) ke liye tan θₚ = 1.52, yani θₚ taqreeban 57°. Is angle par reflect hone wali aur refract hone wali rays ek doosre se 90° par hoti hain. Reflect hone wali light ki vibration sirf plane of incidence ke perpendicular (kaghaz ke andar-bahar) hoti hai, is liye usay dots se dikhaya gaya hai. Refract hone wali light partially polarized hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki Figure 8.6 reflect hone wali plane polarized light par har simt ke teer, aur polaroid ke baad kaghaz ke plane mein ek dohra teer dikhati hai. Sahi yeh hai ke polarizing angle par reflect hone wali light ki vibration sirf plane of incidence ke perpendicular hoti hai; isi liye hamari figure mein dots hain.

Shaffaf (transparent) medium par woh khaas angle of incidence jis par reflect hone wali light taqreeban plane polarized ho, polarizing angle kehlata hai. Maan lein unpolarized light ki beam medium 2 ki satah par parti hai (Fig. 8.6). Agar reflect hone wali beam taqreeban plane polarized ho, to polarizing angle i = θₚ par reflected aur refracted beams ek doosre se 90° par hoti hain. Is liye:

blocks.text_alt: n₁ sin θₚ = n₂ sin θᵣ
n₁ sin θₚ = n₂ sin(90° − θₚ)
n₁ sin θₚ = n₂ cos θₚ

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne teesri line mein dono taraf n₂ likha hai (n₂ sin θₚ = n₂ cos θₚ). Pichhli line se sin(90° − θₚ) = cos θₚ, is liye sahi line n₁ sin θₚ = n₂ cos θₚ hai; isi se aage tan θₚ = n₂/n₁ nikalta hai.

blocks.text_alt: sin θₚ / cos θₚ = n₂ / n₁

blocks.text: Yeh equation Brewster ka law kehlati hai. Is mein n₁ medium 1 ka aur n₂ medium 2 ka refractive index hai. Agar medium 1 hawa ho to n₁ = 1 aur n₂ = n, to equation tan θₚ = n ban jati hai; yahan n us medium ka refractive index hai jis par light parti hai. Yani Brewster ne sabit kiya ke jab medium 1 hawa ho to polarizing angle ka tangent medium 2 ke refractive index ke barabar hai. Woh angle θₚ jis par reflected aur refracted rays ke darmiyan 90° ho, Brewster angle θ_B bhi kehlata hai; tab tan θ_B = n.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: θₚ + θᵣ = 90° ka matlab: polarizing angle par reflected ray aur refracted ray L-shape (90°) banati hain. Sheeshe (n ≈ 1.5) ke liye θₚ ≈ 57°, pani (n ≈ 1.33) ke liye θₚ ≈ 53°.

blocks.title: Interesting Information
blocks.text: Malus ka law biological systems mein light ki polarization parhne ke liye bhi istemal hota hai, maslan cell membranes se light ki polarization.

blocks.title: Example 8.1
blocks.problem: Light ki ek beam √3 refractive index wali sheeshe ki plate par polarizing angle par parti hai. Light ka angle of refraction kya hoga?
steps: Brewster ka law: tan θ_B = n
Polarizing angle par θ_B + θᵣ = 90°, is liye θᵣ = 90° − θ_B = 90° − 60°

blocks.caption: Brewster angle ke taalluqaat
rows: n₁ sin θₚ = n₂ sin θᵣ

blocks.prompt: 1.5 refractive index wali sheeshe ki plate ko hawa mein polarizer ke taur par istemal karna hai; polarizing angle aur angle of refraction nikalein. Pani (n = 1.33) se reflect hone wali light kis angle of incidence par poori polarized hogi (numerical 8.7, 8.8)?
blocks.explanation: θₚ = tan⁻¹ 1.5 = 56.3° aur θᵣ = 90° − 56.3° = 33.7°. Pani ke liye θₚ = tan⁻¹ 1.33 = 53°.

items: Malus (1808): sheeshe se reflect hone wali light polarized hai; sheeshe ke liye taqreeban 57° par plane polarized; mez ki satah ki light partially polarized.
Polarizing (Brewster) angle par reflected aur refracted rays 90° par: θₚ + θᵣ = 90° aur tan θₚ = n₂/n₁ = n (hawa se). Example 8.1: n = √3, θ_B = 60°, θᵣ = 30°.
